{"predictors": [
{"name": "R&D Expense Ratio Volatility", "construction": "Calculate the standard deviation of the ratio of research and development expenses to total assets over the past 5 years, using quarterly data from Compustat.", "rationale": "Firms with volatile R&D expense ratios may be taking on more risky and potentially rewarding projects, leading to higher expected returns.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Inventory Turnover Acceleration", "construction": "Compute the difference in inventory turnover (cost of goods sold divided by average inventory) between the current year and the average of the previous 3 years, using annual data from Compustat.", "rationale": "An increase in inventory turnover may indicate improving operational efficiency or rising demand, leading to higher expected returns.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Director Compensation Variability", "construction": "Calculate the standard deviation of the ratio of total director compensation to total assets over the past 3 years, using annual data from ExecuComp.", "rationale": "Firms with highly variable director compensation may be more likely to take risks and pursue value-maximizing strategies, leading to higher expected returns.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Customer Concentration Index", "construction": "Compute the Herfindahl-Hirschman index of customer concentration using annual data from Compustat, where each customer's sales are weighted by their total revenue.", "rationale": "Firms with low customer concentration may be more resilient to customer-specific shocks and have more stable cash flows, leading to higher expected returns.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Patent Citation Network Centrality", "construction": "Calculate the eigenvector centrality of each firm in the patent citation network, using data from the US Patent and Trademark Office.", "rationale": "Firms with high centrality in the patent citation network may have more valuable and influential intellectual property, leading to higher expected returns.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Employee Stock Option Delta", "construction": "Compute the difference in the delta of employee stock options (sensitivity of option value to stock price) between the current year and the previous year, using annual data from Compustat.", "rationale": "An increase in employee stock option delta may indicate rising employee incentives and motivation, leading to higher expected returns.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Supply Chain Interdependence", "construction": "Calculate the average pairwise correlation of daily stock returns between a firm and its suppliers, using data from CRSP and Compustat.", "rationale": "Firms with high supply chain interdependence may be more vulnerable to supplier-specific shocks and have lower expected returns.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Tax Haven Exposure", "construction": "Compute the proportion of a firm's foreign subsidiaries located in tax haven countries, using data from Compustat and the US Treasury Department.", "rationale": "Firms with high tax haven exposure may be taking on more aggressive tax planning strategies, leading to higher expected returns.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Corporate Governance Index Dispersion", "construction": "Calculate the standard deviation of corporate governance index scores across different governance dimensions (e.g., board independence, executive compensation), using data from RiskMetrics.", "rationale": "Firms with high dispersion in corporate governance index scores may have more inconsistent and potentially value-destroying governance practices, leading to lower expected returns.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Industry-Adjusted Carbon Emissions", "construction": "Compute the difference between a firm's carbon emissions and the industry median, using data from the US Environmental Protection Agency and Compustat.", "rationale": "Firms with high industry-adjusted carbon emissions may face higher regulatory and reputational risks, leading to lower expected returns.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}
]}
